headline: 48 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Second Flat Fire in OR, threatening 832 structures.

active_threats.name: Second Flat
active_threats.narrative: The Second Flat Fire in Harney County, OR has burned 105,854 acres and is 99% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **832 structures threatened**. 6 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 22 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. A wind shift is expected during the window — the kind of transition that is hardest for a 3 km forecast model to time and place precisely. Forecast wind (NE) is not currently aligned toward Hines city, the nearest community of size, 18 miles away.

wind.windninja_applicability: PARTIAL - snapshot before & after the shift; cannot model the transition
